حِلْيَةٌ : see حَلْىٌ, in two places. ―
-b2- Also The quality, or the aggregate of the attributes or qualities, or the state or condition, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) and the make, and form, (K,) and the appearance in respect of colour, or complexion, &c., (Mgh,) of a man: (S, Mgh:) pl. حِلًى and حُلًى. (Mgh, Msb, TA.) A description of the face, or countenance, of a man. (TA.) ―
-b3- الحِلْيَةُ in a trad. respecting الوُضُوْء means [The mode of ablution termed] التَّحْجِيلُ. (TA. [See 2 in art. حجل.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
